_doc: Looks for the 3D view (#503), an experiment behind ?look=<preset> (src/render3d/lookRetro.ts), tuned live in its panel (src/devtools/retroPanel.ts). Each preset is `base` with its own changes. pixel: CSS pixels per chunky pixel (rounded to whole screen pixels); smooth: blur the picture as it's scaled up (N64) rather than keep hard blocks; render: 'colour' (the scene) or 'lines' (edges in ink on paper, with `fill` of the scene's shading and a world grid every `grid` metres, 0 off); colours: 'full', 'palette' (the nearest of paletteSize colours picked from palette, in OKLab) or 'bits' (bits per channel); brightness, contrast, saturation: before the colours are reduced; paint: a Kuwahara filter's radius in pixels, for brush strokes (0 off); fog: how much distance fades to fogColour, from fogNear to fogFar metres; pattern: the dither (off, bayer2, bayer4, bayer8, ps1), dither its spread in sRGB, stableDither pins it to the world so it doesn't crawl; outlines: dark lines where depth jumps (silhouette: how far behind the neighbour must be, as a share of the distance) or bends (crease, on 1/depth, 0 off, to creaseRange metres), how dark each, outlineWidth in pixels; ascii: each pixel drawn as a character by its brightness, in its own colour or in ink (asciiMono), on paper; crt: a curved monitor (curvature) with scanlines, a phosphor mask, colour fringes (aberration), glow and vignette; wobble: snap vertices to a coarse screen grid, this many steps across the screen (0 off); celBands: light in this many hard bands (0 off). wobble and celBands take effect on reload.
